wslc network create --label com.docker.compose.network=default --label com.docker.compose.project=build build_default
wslc build -t build-app -f <DIR>/app/Dockerfile.dev --build-arg VERSION=1.0 <DIR>/app
wslc run -d --name build-app-1 --label com.docker.compose.container-number=1 --label com.docker.compose.oneoff=False --label com.docker.compose.project=build --label com.docker.compose.project.config_files=<DIR>/compose.yaml --label com.docker.compose.project.working_dir=<DIR> --label com.docker.compose.service=app --network build_default --network-alias app -p 3000:3000/tcp build-app
wslc run -d --name build-proxy-1 --label com.docker.compose.container-number=1 --label com.docker.compose.oneoff=False --label com.docker.compose.project=build --label com.docker.compose.project.config_files=<DIR>/compose.yaml --label com.docker.compose.project.working_dir=<DIR> --label com.docker.compose.service=proxy --network build_default --network-alias proxy caddy:2
